1.name: Basic Skill
desc: [color=990000]Right-click the character you wish to trade with to use.[/color]
[color=777777]Use Alt+0–9, Ctrl+1, -, =, and \ to perform emotions. Additional emotions can be used with Alt+L.[/color]
[color=777777]Sit in place to increase HP recovery speed.[/color]
[color=990000]Use by pressing the Insert key or the /sit command.[/color]
[color=777777]Allows creation of a chat room. Use with Alt+C.[/color]
[color=777777]Allows joining a party created by another player.[/color]
[color=777777]Allows access to storage through a Kafra Employee.[/color]
[color=990000]Use with /create [Party Name]. Party options can be adjusted with Alt+Z.[/color]
[color=777777]Allows advancement to a first job class.[/color]

2.name: Sword Mastery
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases physical damage when attacking enemies with a one-handed sword or dagger by an additional amount per skill level.[/color]

3.name: Two Handed Sword Mastery
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases physical damage when attacking enemies with a two-handed sword by an additional amount per skill level.[/color]

4.name: Increase HP Recovery
desc: Description : [color=777777]Recovers additional HP every 10 seconds while standing still. The recovery amount increases based on a fixed value plus a percentage of MHP.[/color]
HP will not be recovered while moving or when penalties that prevent HP/SP recovery due to weight are applied.

5.name: Bash
desc: Description : [color=777777]Strikes a target with great force to deal heavy damage.[/color]
If Fatal Blow has been learned, has a chance to inflict [Status Ailment : Stun] on the target starting from [Lv 6].

6.name: Provoke
desc: Description : [color=777777]Provokes the target, reducing defense based on VIT for players and reducing physical defense for monsters.[/color]
In exchange for reduced defense, the target's attack power increases. When used on monsters, draws their aggression toward the caster.
Does not work on Undead Monsters or boss monsters.

7.name: Magnum Break
desc: Description : [color=777777]Deals Fire-Property physical damage to all enemies within a 5 x 5 cell area around the caster and knocks them back by 2 cells.[/color]
Additionally, adds 20% Fire-Property weapon damage to the caster’s attacks for 10 seconds.

8.name: Endure
desc: Description : [color=777777]Allows the caster to continue moving and attacking while being hit for a certain duration. However, hit stun still occurs when taking damage from magic or skill attacks.[/color]
If the caster is hit 7 times or more while under the Endure status, the effect is removed. This effect does not apply in Siege.

9.name: Increase SP Recovery
desc: Description : [color=777777]Recovers additional SP every 10 seconds while standing still. The recovery amount increases based on a fixed value plus a percentage of MSP.[/color]
SP will not be recovered while moving or when penalties that prevent HP/SP recovery due to weight are applied.

10.name: Sight
desc: Description : [color=777777]Reveals all hidden targets within a 7 x 7 cell area around the caster for 10 seconds.[/color]

11.name: Napalm Beat
desc: Description : [color=777777]Attacks a distant enemy using telekinetic force, dealing Ghost Magical Damage to the target and all enemies within a 3 x 3 cell area around it.[/color]
Damage is distributed among targets when multiple enemies are hit.

12.name: Safety Wall
desc: Description : [color=777777]Creates a magical barrier at the designated location that blocks a fixed number of enemy attacks. The barrier disappears when its durability is depleted or when the Duration expires.[/color]
Only melee physical attacks are blocked. Casting this skill requires 1 Blue Gemstone.
[color=777777]The barrier’s durability is additionally increased based on the caster’s INT, Base Level, and MSP.[/color]
The first blocked hit may negate damage exceeding the barrier’s total durability.

13.name: Soul Strike
desc: Description : [color=777777]Summons ancient spirits to directly strike the target, dealing Ghost Magical Damage equal to MATK 100%.[/color]
Deals additional damage to Undead-Property enemies.

14.name: Cold Bolt
desc: Description : [color=777777]Fires an icy Arrow at the target, dealing Water Magical Damage equal to MATK 100%.[/color]
Damage is further increased based on the caster’s INT.

15.name: Frost Driver
desc: Description : [color=777777]Deals Water Magical Damage to the target and has a chance to inflict [Status Ailment : Frozen].[/color]
The chance and duration of Frozen are affected by the target’s level, magic defense, and LUK.

16.name: Stone Curse
desc: Description : [color=777777]Inflicts the [Status Ailment : Petrification] status on the target. Consumes 1 Red Gemstone upon use.[/color]
Starting from skill level 6, Red Gemstone is only consumed if the skill is successfully cast.
The chance and duration of Petrification are affected by the target’s level, magic defense, and LUK.

17.name: Fire Ball
desc: Description : [color=777777]Hurls a fireball at the target, dealing Fire Magical Damage to the target and enemies within a 5 x 5 cell area.[/color]
Damage differs between the center area (3 x 3 cells) and the outer area (5 x 5 cells).

18.name: Fire Wall
desc: Description : [color=777777]Creates a wall of fire that deals Fire Magical Damage equal to MATK 50% to approaching enemies and knocks them back by 2 cells.[/color]
[color=777777]Up to 3 walls can be placed at the same time.[/color]

19.name: Fire Bolt
desc: Description : [color=777777]Fires a flame-forged Arrow at the target, dealing Fire Magical Damage equal to MATK 100%.[/color]
Damage is further increased based on the caster’s INT.

20.name: Lightning Bolt
desc: Description : [color=777777]Calls down a bolt of lightning on the target, dealing Wind Magical Damage equal to MATK 100%.[/color]
Damage is further increased based on the caster’s INT.

21.name: Thunder Storm
desc: Description : [color=777777]Calls down lightning at the designated location, dealing Wind Magical Damage equal to MATK 100% to enemies within a 5 x 5 cell area.[/color]
Damage is further increased based on the caster’s INT.

22.name: Divine Protection
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases defense against attacks from Demon Monsters and Undead-Property enemies. Damage reduction increases as the character’s level rises.[/color]
The damage reduction is subtracted from the final damage taken from Demon Monsters and Undead-Property enemies.

23.name: Demon Bane
desc: Description : [color=777777]Enhances attacks against Demon Monsters and Undead-Property enemies. Attack power increases as the character’s level rises.[/color]
Additional damage is added to attacks against Demon Monsters and Physical Damage to Undead Enemies.

24.name: Ruwach
desc: Description : [color=777777]Reveals all hidden targets within a 5 x 5 cell area around the caster for 10 seconds.[/color]
If a revealed target is an enemy, deals Holy Magical Damage equal to MATK 145%.

25.name: Pneuma
desc: Description : [color=777777]Creates a protective area at the designated location and within a 3 x 3 cell radius for 10 seconds, blocking ranged physical damage.[/color]

26.name: Teleport
desc: Description : [color=777777]Instantly moves the caster to another location.[/color]
Cannot be used while under the effect of Land Protector.
[Lv 1] [color=777777]Teleports to a random location on the current map[/color]

27.name: Warp Portal
desc: Description : [color=777777]Creates a dimensional portal at the designated location that transports players to another area. Up to 8 players can be transported regardless of skill level, and 1 Blue Gemstone is consumed.[/color]
Cannot be used while under the effect of Land Protector.
[Custom Location] [color=777777]Refers to a memorized location. Use the [/memo] command on the desired map to register it.[/color]

28.name: Heal
desc: Description : [color=777777]Recovers the target player’s HP. In addition to the base Heal effect determined by skill level, the recovery amount is further increased based on the caster’s level, total INT, and the base and refined magic attack power of the equipped weapon.[/color]
When used on Undead-Property monsters, deals special Holy Magical Damage equal to 50% of the Heal effect.

29.name: Increase Agility
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases the target’s movement speed for a certain duration and additionally increases ASPD (reduces After Attack Delay). Consumes an additional 15 HP upon use.[/color]
When used on a target afflicted with [Status Ailment : Decrease Agility], the status is removed and the Increase Agility effect is applied.

30.name: Decrease Agility
desc: Description : [color=777777]Attempts to inflict [Status Ailment : Decrease Agility] on the target for a certain duration.[/color]
While active, the target’s AGI is reduced and movement speed is decreased.

31.name: Aqua Benedicta
desc: Description : [color=777777]Fills an Empty Bottle with holy water, creating 1 Holy Water. Must be used while standing in shallow water.[/color]

32.name: Signum Crucis
desc: Description : [color=777777]Etches the sign of the cross to reduce the physical defense of Demon-type and Undead Monsters on the screen.[/color]

33.name: Angelus
desc: Description : [color=777777]Recites a sacred prayer to increase physical defense based on VIT and Max HP for the caster and all party members on screen for a certain duration.[/color]

34.name: Blessing
desc: Description : [color=777777]Temporarily increases the target’s STR, INT, DEX, and HIT.[/color]
When used on a player afflicted with Curse or Petrification, cures the Status Ailment.
When used on Undead or Demon Monsters, reduces STR, INT, and DEX by 50%.

35.name: Cure
desc: Description : [color=777777]Cures the Status Ailment when used on a player afflicted with Silence, Confusion, or Blind.[/color]

36.name: Enlarge Weight Limit
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases the maximum weight capacity for carrying items.[/color]

37.name: Discount
desc: Description : [color=777777]Allows items to be purchased from standard NPC shops at a reduced price compared to the base cost.[/color]

38.name: Overcharge
desc: Description : [color=777777]Allows items to be sold to NPC shops at a higher price than the standard offer.[/color]

39.name: Pushcart
desc: Description : [color=777777]Allows use of a cart capable of carrying large quantities of items.[/color]
The cart can be rented from a Kafra Employee and accessed with the [Alt+W] key.
At Lv. 1, movement speed is reduced while using a cart, but the penalty is gradually reduced as skill level increases, fully removed at Lv. 10.
Items stored in the cart cannot be used directly.

41.name: Vending
desc: Description : [color=777777]Can only be used while a cart is equipped. Opens a temporary shop at the current location to sell various items.[/color]
Only items stored in the cart can be sold, and the number of different items that can be listed increases with skill level.

42.name: Mammonite
desc: Description : [color=777777]Strikes a designated enemy with a powerful blow fueled by wealth.[/color]

44.name: Vulture's Eye
desc: Description : [color=777777]When using a bow, increases attack range and improves HIT.[/color]

45.name: Improve Concentration
desc: Additionally, when Improve Concentration is cast, hidden targets within a 3×3 cell area around the caster are revealed.

46.name: Double Strafe
desc: Description : [color=777777]Fires a single Arrow at the target, striking twice.[/color]
The base range of Double Strafe is 9 cells.

47.name: Arrow Shower
desc: Description : [color=777777]Fires a single Arrow at the designated location, dealing Ranged Physical Damage to enemies within a 3×3 cell area.[/color]
Targets hit are additionally knocked back by 2 cells from the center.
The base range of Arrow Shower is 9 cells.

48.name: Double Attack
desc: Description : [color=777777]When attacking with a dagger, grants a chance to perform a double attack.[/color]
The activation chance increases with skill level, and a bonus to HIT is also applied.
When using Katar-type weapons, this skill affects damage dealt by the left hand.

49.name: Improve Dodge
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases the chance to evade enemy attacks. After second job advancement, the amount of FLEE Rate gained is increased.[/color]
For Assassin Class, an additional movement speed increase effect is also applied.

50.name: Steal
desc: Description : [color=777777]Attempts to steal an item carried by the target. The success rate decreases as the target’s DEX becomes higher than the caster’s.[/color]
This skill does not work on Boss monsters or players, and an item cannot be stolen more than once from the same target.

51.name: Hiding
desc: Description : [color=777777]Hides underground. Can be detected by enemy detection skills.[/color]
Can be detected by Demon-type enemies, Insect Monsters, and Boss monsters. Using Hiding again while hidden will cancel the Hiding state.
Natural SP recovery is disabled while hidden.
[Lv 1] [color=777777]Duration: 30 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 5 sec[/color]
[Lv 2] [color=777777]Duration: 60 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 6 sec[/color]
[Lv 3] [color=777777]Duration: 90 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 7 sec[/color]
[Lv 4] [color=777777]Duration: 120 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 8 sec[/color]
[Lv 5] [color=777777]Duration: 150 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 9 sec[/color]
[Lv 6] [color=777777]Duration: 180 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 10 sec[/color]
[Lv 7] [color=777777]Duration: 210 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 11 sec[/color]
[Lv 8] [color=777777]Duration: 240 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 12 sec[/color]
[Lv 9] [color=777777]Duration: 270 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 13 sec[/color]
[Lv 10] [color=777777]Duration: 300 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 14 sec[/color]

52.name: Envenom
desc: Description : [color=777777]Deals Poison-Property physical damage to a target. Has a chance to inflict [Status Ailment : Poison].[/color]
Poisoned targets take damage proportional to MHP every second, and their physical defense is reduced by 25%.
The damage bonus from Envenom is added to normal physical attack damage.

53.name: Detoxify
desc: Description : [color=777777]Cures the Poison Status Ailment when used on a poisoned player.[/color]

54.name: Resurrection
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Increase SP Recovery Lv. 4, Status Recovery Lv. 1[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Blue Gemstone to revive an incapacitated player.[/color]

55.name: Spear Mastery
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases physical damage when attacking with a spear.[/color]
Damage is further increased while mounted.

56.name: Pierce
desc: Deals melee physical damage with multiple hits based on target size.
Damage increases with STR, and HIT is increased when used.

57.name: Brandish Spear
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Peco Peco Ride Lv. 1, Spear Stab Lv. 3[/color]
Can only be used while mounted.
Swings the spear in a wide arc, dealing Ranged Physical Damage in a forward area from the caster toward the target.
Damage is further increased based on the caster’s STR.
Has a short preparation time, during which weapon switching is not possible.

58.name: Spear Stab
desc: Thrusts the spear deeply, dealing Ranged Physical Damage to the target and all enemies between the caster and the target.

59.name: Spear Boomerang
desc: Throws a spear at the target, dealing Ranged Physical Damage.
At Lv. 1, deals Melee Physical Damage instead.

60.name: Two Hand Quicken
desc: Increases CRIT, HIT, and ASPD for a duration.
The effect is canceled if a weapon other than a two-handed sword is equipped or unequipped.
Also removed by Quagmire and Decrease Agility.

61.name: Counter Attack
desc: Description : [color=777777]During the counter window, blocks a frontal melee physical attack and automatically counterattacks.[/color]
The counterattack is a normal physical attack, not a skill attack, and can critically hit.

62.name: Bowling Bash
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Bash Lv. 10, Magnum Break Lv. 3, Two Handed Sword Mastery Lv. 5, Two Hand Quicken Lv. 10, Counter Attack Lv. 5[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Deals Melee Physical Damage to the target 3 times and knocks it back.[/color]
When using a two-handed sword, the number of hits increases based on nearby enemies, up to a maximum of 5 hits.
Damage is further increased based on the caster’s STR, and weapon switching is disabled briefly after use.

63.name: Peco Peco Ride
desc: Description : [color=777777]Allows the character to ride a trained Peco Peco.[/color]
You can obtain directions to the ‘Pecopeco Trainer’ from the Guide in each city.

64.name: Cavalier Mastery
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases movement speed while riding a Peco Peco and allows attacking while mounted.[/color]
However, ASPD is reduced; when using Pub Playmate, ASPD is restored to normal.

65.name: Mace Mastery
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases CRIT when attacking with a mace-type weapon, and adds bonus physical damage based on skill level.[/color]

66.name: Impositio Manus
desc: Description : [color=777777]Bestows a blessing that increases ATK and MATK for yourself and nearby party members for 120 seconds.[/color]

67.name: Suffragium
desc: Description : [color=777777]Offers a prayer on behalf of others, reducing Variable Casting Time for yourself and nearby party members for 60 seconds.[/color]

68.name: Aspersio
desc: Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Holy Water to temporarily grant Holy-Property to the target’s weapon.[/color]

69.name: B.S Sacramenti
desc: Description : [color=777777]Performs a sacred rite of Eucharistic adoration.[/color]
Grants Holy-Property to the armor of players within a 3 x 3 cells area around the blessed ground.
Requires two additional Acolyte Class characters, one standing on each adjacent side of the caster.
When used on Undead-Property or Demon Monsters, deals a fixed amount of Holy-Property damage.

70.name: Sanctuary
desc: Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Blue Gemstone to create a consecrated sanctuary in a 5 x 5 cells area.[/color]
Recovers HP of targets within the area once every second. Skill level increases Duration, Heal effect, and the maximum number of targets.
If Undead-Property or Demon Monsters enter the area, deals Holy Magical Damage equal to half of the Heal effect and knocks them back by 2 cells.

72.name: Status Recovery
desc: Description : [color=777777]Cures severe Status Ailment effects such as Frozen, Stone Curse, and certain special skill effects.[/color]
When used on Undead Monsters, inflicts [Status Ailment: Blind].

73.name: Kyrie Eleison
desc: Description : [color=777777]Grants a protective barrier to a single player for 120 seconds.[/color]
The barrier’s durability is based on the target’s Max HP. Skill level increases durability and the maximum number of blocked attacks.
The barrier is removed if hit by Holy Light.

74.name: Magnificat
desc: Description : [color=777777]Doubles the natural SP recovery rate of the caster and party members on screen for a set duration.[/color]

75.name: Gloria
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases LUK by 30 for the caster and party members on screen for a set duration.[/color]

76.name: Lex Divina
desc: Description : [color=777777]Has a chance to inflict [Status Ailment: Silence] on the target.[/color]
The base Silence Duration is determined by skill level but may be reduced depending on the target’s status.
When used on a target already affected by [Status Ailment: Silence], removes that status.

77.name: Turn Undead
desc: Description : [color=777777]Has a chance to instantly destroy an Undead-Property monster.[/color]
If the attempt fails, deals Holy Magical Damage equal to 30% of MATK.

78.name: Lex Aeterna
desc: Description : [color=777777]Applies a state to the target that causes the next attack to deal double damage.[/color]
Cannot be used on targets affected by Frozen or petrification.

79.name: Magnus Exorcismus
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Turn Undead Lv. 3, Lex Aeterna Lv. 1, Safety Wall Lv. 1[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Blue Gemstone to create a giant holy cross on the ground.[/color]
Enemies within the area take Holy Magical Damage equal to 100% of MATK once every 3 seconds.
Demon Monsters, Undead-Property, and Shadow-Property enemies take 130% of MATK as Holy Magical Damage per hit.

80.name: Fire Pillar
desc: Description : [color=777777]Summons a pillar of fire at the targeted location, dealing Fire Magical Damage to enemies that step on it.[/color]
If no one triggers it within 30 seconds of Duration, the pillar disappears naturally.
Up to 5 pillars can be placed at once. From Lv. 6 onward, consumes 1 Blue Gemstone.
Cannot be placed if any ally or enemy, including the caster, is within 3 x 3 cells around the target cell.

81.name: Sightrasher
desc: Description : [color=777777]Scatters the fire orbs summoned by Sight in eight directions, dealing Fire Magical Damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back by 2 cells.[/color]
After use, the fire orbs summoned by Sight disappear.

83.name: Meteor Storm
desc: Description : [color=777777]Calls down meteors over a 13 x 13 area around the targeted cell, dealing Fire Magical Damage equal to 125% of MATK and inflicting [Status Ailment : Stun] with a certain chance.[/color]
Each meteor affects a 7 x 7 area. Damage is further increased based on the caster’s INT, and the number of meteors and hits per meteor increase with skill level.

84.name: Jupitel Thunder
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Napalm Beat Lv. 1, Lightning Bolt Lv. 1[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Launches a lightning orb at the target, dealing Wind Magical Damage equal to 100% of MATK and knocking the target back once per hit.[/color]
The number of hits increases with skill level.

85.name: Lord of Vermilion
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Thunder Storm Lv. 1, Jupitel Thunder Lv. 3[/color]

Description : [color=777777]Summons concentrated lightning strikes over a 13 x 13 area around the targeted cell, dealing Wind Magical Damage and inflicting [Status Ailment : Blind] with a certain chance.[/color]
The chance to inflict Blind is reduced by the target’s Status Ailment resistance, and damage is further increased based on the caster’s INT.

86.name: Waterball
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Cold Bolt Lv. 1, Lightning Bolt Lv. 1[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Can only be used when there is water within the caster’s nearby area.[/color]
Attacks the target repeatedly based on the number of water-filled cells within range, dealing Water Magical Damage.
The detection range increases with skill level, and the skill can also be used on areas affected by skills such as Deluge.
[Lv 1] [color=777777]Damage per hit: MATK 130%, Detection Range: 1 x 1[/color]
[Lv 2] [color=777777]Damage per hit: MATK 160%, Detection Range: 3 x 3[/color]
[Lv 3] [color=777777]Damage per hit: MATK 190%, Detection Range: 3 x 3[/color]
[Lv 4] [color=777777]Damage per hit: MATK 220%, Detection Range: 5 x 5[/color]
[Lv 5] [color=777777]Damage per hit: MATK 250%, Detection Range: 5 x 5[/color]

87.name: Ice Wall
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Stone Curse Lv. 1, Frost Driver Lv. 1[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Creates a 1 x 5 wall of ice with Neutral-Property on the ground.[/color]
Enemies cannot pass through the wall, but ranged attacks such as Arrow attacks can pass through it.
The wall has durability based on skill level, which decreases by 50 per second after placement and disappears when it reaches 0.

88.name: Frost Nova
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Frost Driver Lv. 1, Ice Wall Lv. 1[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Deals Water Magical Damage to enemies within a 5 x 5 area around the caster and inflicts [Status Ailment : Frozen].[/color]
The base chance to inflict Frozen and its duration increase with skill level.

89.name: Storm Gust
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Frost Driver Lv. 1, Jupitel Thunder Lv. 1[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Unleashes a blizzard over an 11 x 11 area at the targeted location, dealing Water Magical Damage to enemies.[/color]
Damage is increased based on the caster’s INT. The blizzard lasts 4.5 seconds, striking once every 0.45 seconds and knocking targets back by 2 cells.
Damaged targets have a chance to be inflicted with [Status Ailment : Frozen], and while Frozen is active, they do not take damage.

90.name: Earth Spike
desc: Description : [color=777777]Causes spikes of earth to erupt beneath the target, dealing Earth Magical Damage equal to MATK 200%.[/color]
Damage is increased based on the caster’s INT, and the number of hits increases with skill level.

91.name: Heaven's Drive
desc: Description : [color=777777]Causes the ground within a 5 x 5 area at the targeted location to erupt, dealing Earth Magical Damage equal to MATK 200% to targets within range.[/color]
Hidden targets underground are also damaged and revealed.
Damage is further increased based on the caster’s INT, and the number of hits increases with skill level.

92.name: Quagmire
desc: Description : [color=777777]Creates a muddy swamp in a 5 x 5 area at the targeted location, reducing the movement speed and AGI and DEX of targets within range by half.[/color]
AGI and DEX can be reduced up to a maximum of 50, and players are affected at only half effectiveness.
If the target is under certain movement speed–increasing or ASPD-increasing effects, those effects are removed.
Up to 3 instances of Quagmire can be active at once. If placement exceeds the limit, a new one can only be placed after an existing Quagmire fully expires.

93.name: Sense
desc: Description : [color=777777]Displays detailed information about the targeted monster to the caster and the caster’s party members.[/color]

94.name: Iron Tempering
desc: Description : [color=777777]Allows the creation of 1 Iron using 1 Iron Ore by consuming 1 Portable Furnace.[/color]
The success rate increases with skill level.
Success rate is further increased based on the caster’s DEX and LUK.

95.name: Steel Tempering
desc: Description : [color=777777]Allows the creation of 1 Steel using 5 Iron and 1 Coal by consuming 1 Portable Furnace.[/color]
The success rate increases with skill level.
Success rate is further increased based on the caster’s DEX and LUK.

96.name: Enchanted Stone Craft
desc: Description : [color=777777]Allows the creation of 1 elemental stone by consuming 10 elemental ores of the same property and 1 Portable Furnace.[/color]
The success rate increases with skill level.
Success rate is further increased based on the caster’s DEX and LUK.

98.name: Smith Dagger
desc: Description : [color=777777]Allows the creation of Daggers by consuming 1 Hammer (Steel, Golden, or Oridecon Hammer).[/color]
Required materials and an Anvil must be in the caster’s inventory.
The success rate increases with skill level.
Success rate is further increased based on the caster’s DEX and LUK.

99.name: Smith Sword
desc: Description : [color=777777]Allows the creation of One-handed Swords by consuming 1 Hammer (Steel, Golden, or Oridecon Hammer).[/color]
Required materials and an Anvil must be in the caster’s inventory.
The success rate increases with skill level.
Success rate is further increased based on the caster’s DEX and LUK.

100.name: Smith Two-handed Sword
desc: Description : [color=777777]Allows the creation of Two-handed Swords by consuming 1 Hammer (Steel, Golden, or Oridecon Hammer).[/color]
Required materials and an Anvil must be in the caster’s inventory.
The success rate increases with skill level.
Success rate is further increased based on the caster’s DEX and LUK.

101.name: Smith Axe
desc: Description : [color=777777]Allows the creation of Axes by consuming 1 Hammer (Steel, Golden, or Oridecon Hammer).[/color]
Required materials and an Anvil must be in the caster’s inventory.
The success rate increases with skill level.
Success rate is further increased based on the caster’s DEX and LUK.

102.name: Smith Mace
desc: Description : [color=777777]Allows the creation of Maces by consuming 1 Hammer (Steel, Golden, or Oridecon Hammer).[/color]
Required materials and an Anvil must be in the caster’s inventory.
The success rate increases with skill level.
Success rate is further increased based on the caster’s DEX and LUK.

103.name: Smith Knuckle
desc: Description : [color=777777]Allows the creation of Knuckles by consuming 1 Hammer (Steel, Golden, or Oridecon Hammer).[/color]
Required materials and an Anvil must be in the caster’s inventory.
The success rate increases with skill level.
Success rate is further increased based on the caster’s DEX and LUK.

104.name: Smith Spear
desc: Description : [color=777777]Allows the creation of Spears by consuming 1 Hammer (Steel, Golden, or Oridecon Hammer).[/color]
Required materials and an Anvil must be in the caster’s inventory.
The success rate increases with skill level.
Success rate is further increased based on the caster’s DEX and LUK.

105.name: Hilt Binding
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases STR by 1 and Physical Damage by 4.[/color]
Increases the Duration of Adrenaline Rush, Power Thrust, and Weapon Perfection by 10%.

106.name: Ore Discovery
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Hilt Binding Lv. 1, Steel Tempering Lv. 1[/color]
Description : [color=777777]When defeating monsters, grants a chance to obtain Ore-type items.[/color]

107.name: Weaponry Research
desc: Adds Physical Damage based on skill level when attacking.

108.name: Repair Weapon
desc: Required materials vary by equipment type.

109.name: Skin Tempering
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases resistance to Fire, improving Fire-Property and Neutral-Property resistance.[/color]

110.name: Hammerfall
desc: Description : [color=777777]Strikes the ground with a hammer, causing a shockwave.[/color]
Has a chance to inflict [Status Ailment : Stun] on enemies within a 5 x 5 cell area.
The success rate and Duration of Stun are reduced based on the target’s VIT.

111.name: Adrenaline Rush
desc: For the duration, increases ASPD of the caster and party members wielding Axes or Maces.
If the target is a Blacksmith-class character, ASPD is increased further.

112.name: Weapon Perfection
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Adrenaline Rush Lv. 2, Weaponry Research Lv. 2[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Removes weapon size penalties for the duration.[/color]

113.name: Power Thrust
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases Physical Damage of the caster and nearby party members.[/color]
Adds bonus Physical Damage per skill level when attacking, with different values applied to the caster and party members.

114.name: Maximize Power
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Weapon Perfection Lv. 3, Power Thrust Lv. 2[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Draws out the weapon’s maximum potential, allowing attacks to deal maximum damage.[/color]
While active, SP is continuously consumed, and the skill must be used again to deactivate it.
SP does not naturally recover while this effect is active.

115.name: Skid Trap
desc: Description : [color=777777]Uses 1 Deployable Trap to set a trap that causes enemies who step on it to slide in a designated direction.[/color]
Targets that slide are unable to move for 3 seconds.
If not triggered, the trap is removed when its active duration ends and returns as a Deployable Trap.

116.name: Land Mine
desc: Description : [color=777777]Uses 1 Deployable Trap to set a trap that explodes when an enemy steps within a 3 x 3 cell area around it,[/color]
Damage increases based on skill level, the caster’s Base Level, DEX, and INT.
If not triggered, the trap is removed when its active duration ends and returns as a Deployable Trap.

117.name: Anklesnare
desc: Description : [color=777777]Uses 1 Deployable Trap to set a trap that immobilizes enemies for a certain duration when they step within a 3 x 3 cell area.[/color]
The immobilization duration is reduced as the target’s AGI increases.
If not triggered, the trap is removed when its active duration ends and returns as a Deployable Trap.

118.name: Shockwave Trap
desc: Description : [color=777777]Uses 2 Deployable Trap to set a trap that drains the target’s SP when stepped on within a 3 x 3 cell area.[/color]
If not triggered, the trap is removed when its active duration ends and returns as a Deployable Trap.

119.name: Sandman
desc: Description : [color=777777]Uses 1 Deployable Trap to set a trap that inflicts [Status Ailment : Sleep] on the target that steps on it and on enemies within a surrounding 5 x 5 cell area.[/color]
If not triggered, the trap is removed when its active duration ends and returns as a Deployable Trap.
The chance to inflict Sleep is reduced based on the target’s Status Ailment resistance.

120.name: Flasher
desc: Description : [color=777777]Uses 2 Deployable Trap to set a trap that emits a sudden flash when stepped on, inflicting [Status Ailment : Blind].[/color]
The chance to inflict Blind is always 100% regardless of skill level, but is reduced based on the target’s Status Ailment resistance.

121.name: Freezing Trap
desc: Description : [color=777777]Uses 2 Deployable Trap to set a trap that deals special Water-Property damage and inflicts [Status Ailment : Frozen] when stepped on.[/color]
The chance to inflict Frozen is always 100%, but is reduced based on the target’s Status Ailment resistance.

122.name: Blast Mine
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Sandman Lv. 1, Land Mine Lv. 1, Freezing Trap Lv. 1[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Uses 2 Deployable Trap to set a trap that explodes either when stepped on within a 3 x 3 cell area or automatically when its active duration ends,[/color]
Blast Mine can be attacked and pushed to a different location before it explodes.

123.name: Claymore Trap
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Blast Mine Lv. 1, Shockwave Trap Lv. 1[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Uses 2 Deployable Trap to set a trap that explodes instantly when an enemy steps within a surrounding 5 x 5 cell area, dealing special Fire-Property damage.[/color]
Claymore Trap can also be detonated by directly attacking it.

124.name: Remove Trap
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Land Mine Lv. 1, Double Strafe Lv. 5[/color]
When a trap is removed, the trap item used for its installation is recovered.

125.name: Talkie Box
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Remove Trap Lv. 1, Shockwave Trap Lv. 1[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Deployable Trap to set a trap that displays a preset message when a player steps within a surrounding 3 x 3 cell area.[/color]
The message is shown above the target’s head, and the trap is removed afterward.

126.name: Beastbane
desc: Description : [color=777777]When attacking Brute- and Insect-type enemies, additional physical damage is added based on skill level.[/color]

127.name: Falconry Mastery
desc: Description : [color=777777]Allows borrowing a hunting falcon from the Hunter guild.[/color]
Additionally, enables summoning a falcon using Falcon Whistle.

128.name: Steel Crow
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases the damage dealt by falcon-based attacks.[/color]

129.name: Blitz Beat
desc: Description : [color=777777]Commands the falcon to strike the target and enemies within a 3 x 3 cell area.[/color]
Falcon damage increases based on the caster’s AGI and DEX.
Additionally, basic attacks gain a chance to automatically trigger a falcon attack, with the activation chance increased by the caster’s LUK.
The falcon’s attack range is equal to the range of the learned Vulture's Eye skill plus 3 cells.

130.name: Detect
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 1, Falconry Mastery Lv. 1[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Sends the falcon to the selected location to reveal hidden traps and concealed targets within a 7 x 7 cell area.[/color]

131.name: Spring Trap
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Remove Trap Lv. 1, Falconry Mastery Lv. 1[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Uses the falcon to instantly activate one of your deployed traps.[/color]

132.name: Righthand Mastery
desc: Description : [color=777777]Restores the right-hand damage penalty when dual wielding.[/color]

133.name: Lefthand Mastery
desc: Description : [color=777777]Restores the left-hand damage penalty when dual wielding.[/color]

134.name: Katar Mastery
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases physical damage when using Katar weapons.[/color]

135.name: Cloaking
desc: Description : [color=777777]Moves unseen by using blind spots.[/color]
Movement speed increases along walls but decreases away from them.
Consumes 1 SP at intervals based on skill level and disables natural SP recovery.
Detected by Demon-type, Insect Monsters, and Boss monsters.
[color=993300] -After the effect ends, items cannot be picked up for 3 seconds.[/color]

136.name: Sonic Blow
desc: Rapidly strikes the target to deal Melee Physical Damage.
Has a chance to inflict [Status Ailment : Stun].
Deals 50% more damage if the target’s HP is below 50%.

137.name: Grimtooth
desc: When using Grimtooth while under Hiding, deals Ranged Physical Damage to the target and enemies in a 3 x 3 cells area.
Against normal monsters, hit targets have their Movement Speed reduced by 50% for 1 second.

138.name: Enchant Poison
desc: Description : [color=777777]Enchants the target’s weapon with Poison-Property.[/color]
Attacks with the enchanted weapon have a chance to inflict [Status Ailment : Poison].
The effect is removed if the weapon is unequipped or changed.

139.name: Poison React
desc: Description : [color=777777]Assumes a counter stance against poison attacks.[/color]
When attacked by Poison-Property monsters, counterattacks once, dealing Melee Physical Damage.
If Double Attack is learned, its activation chance applies on the counter.
When attacked by non-poison monsters or players, automatically casts Envenom Lv. 5 a set number of times on the attacker.

140.name: Venom Dust
desc: Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Red Gemstone to spread poison on the target cell and a 3 x 3 cells area.[/color]
Targets entering the area have a chance to be inflicted with [Status Ailment : Poison].
The chance is reduced by the target’s Status Ailment resistance.

141.name: Venom Splasher
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Poison React Lv. 5, Venom Dust Lv. 5[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Plants a timed explosive on the target.[/color]
After the delay, it explodes, dealing Melee Physical Damage and inflicting [Status Ailment : Poison] to enemies within a 5 x 5 cells area.
The poison chance is reduced by the target’s Status Ailment resistance.

143.name: Play Dead
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest., Novice-exclusive skill[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Feigns death to avoid enemy threats for 30 seconds.[/color]
The effect ends if hit by area attacks or affected by Provoke.

144.name: HP Recovery While Moving
desc: Description : [color=777777]Allows HP recovery while moving, at 25% of the recovery rate while standing still.[/color]
Does not receive bonus recovery from Increase HP Recovery.

145.name: Fatal Blow
desc: Description : [color=777777]When using Bash at Lv. 6 or higher, has a chance to inflict [Status Ailment : Stun].[/color]
The chance increases with the level of Bash used and the character’s level.

146.name: Berserk
desc: Description : [color=777777]Enters a berserk state when HP falls to 25% or lower.[/color]
This state is equivalent to being affected by Provoke Lv. 10 and persists until the critical condition ends.
The effect is removed by skills or situations that cancel Provoke.

147.name: Arrow Crafting
desc: Description : [color=777777]Converts the selected item into Arrow.[/color]
The arrow type and quantity depend on the item used.
[color=990000]Cannot be used if current weight exceeds 70% for Merchant.[/color]

148.name: Arrow Repel
desc: Description : [color=777777]Fires an Arrow with great force.[/color]
Deals Ranged Physical Damage equal to ATK 150% and knocks the target back by 4 cells.

149.name: Sand Attack
desc: Description : [color=777777]Throws sand at the target, dealing Earth-Property melee physical damage equal to ATK 130%.[/color]
Has a chance to inflict [Status Ailment : Blind].

150.name: Back Slide
desc: Description : [color=777777]Slides backward by 5 cells, allowing you to evade enemy threats safely.[/color]

151.name: Find Stone
desc: Description : [color=777777]Picks up a stone from the ground.[/color]
Cannot be used if current weight exceeds 70%.

152.name: Stone Fling
desc: Description : [color=777777]Throws a stone at the target, dealing a fixed 50 Ranged Physical Damage that ignores DEF.[/color]
Consumes 1 stone and has a low chance to inflict Stun or Blind.

153.name: Cart Revolution
desc: Description : [color=777777]Can be used while a cart is equipped.[/color]
Strikes the target and enemies within 3 x 3 cells with special Melee Physical Damage.
Base damage is ATK 150% and increases with cart weight.

154.name: Change Cart
desc: Description : [color=777777]Can be used while a cart is equipped.[/color]
Changes the cart’s appearance based on your level.
More cart styles become available as your level increases.

155.name: Crazy Uproar
desc: Description : [color=777777]Lets out a powerful shout to boost morale.[/color]
For 5 min, increases STR by 4 and ATK by 30 for yourself and on-screen party members.

156.name: Holy Light
desc: Description : [color=777777]Strikes the target with holy light, dealing MATK 125% Holy Magical Damage.[/color]
Removes Kyrie Eleison from the target if active.

157.name: Energy Coat
desc: Description : [color=777777]Surrounds the caster with mental energy, reducing physical and magical damage taken.[/color]
Higher current SP increases damage reduction but consumes more SP per hit.

210.name: Gank
desc: Description : [color=777777]When performing a normal melee attack, has a chance to automatically attempt Steal on the target.[/color]
The activation chance increases with skill level and is affected by the learned level of Steal.

212.name: Back Stab
desc: Description : [color=777777]Strikes the target from behind to deal Melee Physical Damage.[/color]
Damage is halved when used with a bow; when used with a dagger, the attack hits twice.
Grants a HIT bonus based on skill level when cast.

213.name: Stalk
desc: Movement speed while hidden is slower than normal.

214.name: Sightless Mind
desc: Description : [color=777777]Can only be used while under Hiding.[/color]
Ends Hiding and deals damage to enemies within 7 x 7 cells, with a chance to inflict Stun and Blind.
Damage increases based on the caster’s DEX and AGI.
Affected targets take increased damage for 10 sec (30%, or 15% for boss monsters).
Status ailment chance is reduced by the target’s resistance.

215.name: Divest Weapon
desc: Description : [color=777777]Attempts to strip the target’s weapon.[/color]
In PvP, unequips the weapon and prevents re-equipping for a duration.
Against monsters, reduces ATK by 25% for a duration.
Success chance and Duration increase with skill level and the caster’s DEX, and are reduced by the target’s DEX.

216.name: Divest Shield
desc: Description : [color=777777]Attempts to strip the target’s shield.[/color]
In PvP, unequips the shield and prevents re-equipping for a duration.
Against monsters, reduces DEF by 15% for a duration.
Success chance and Duration increase with skill level and the caster’s DEX, and are reduced by the target’s DEX.

217.name: Divest Armor
desc: Description : [color=777777]Attempts to strip the target’s armor.[/color]
In PvP, unequips the armor and prevents re-equipping for a duration.
Against monsters, reduces VIT by 40% for a duration. This does not affect HP.
Success chance and Duration increase with skill level and the caster’s DEX, and are reduced by the target’s DEX.

218.name: Divest Helm
desc: Description : [color=777777]Attempts to strip the target’s helm.[/color]
In PvP, unequips the helm and prevents re-equipping for a duration.
Against monsters, reduces INT by 40% for a duration. This does not affect SP.
Success chance and Duration increase with skill level and the caster’s DEX, and are reduced by the target’s DEX.

219.name: Snatch
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Sightless Mind Lv. 5, Back Stab Lv. 4[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Deals Melee Physical Damage to the target and warps both the caster and the target to a random location on the map.[/color]
Has no effect on boss monsters. Success chance increases with higher caster level and lower target level.

220.name: Scribble
desc: Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Red Gemstone to place custom graffiti around the selected cell.[/color]
The caster can enter up to about 20 characters using English letters and numbers.
Only one Scribble can exist at a time.

223.name: Slyness
desc: Description : [color=777777]If another Rogue Class player is sitting within 3 x 3 cells around you while you are sitting, monsters will not attack you or that Rogue.[/color]
Has no effect on boss monsters.

224.name: Haggle
desc: Description : [color=777777]Reduces purchase prices at normal NPC shops.[/color]

225.name: Intimidate
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases ASPD based on skill level (reduces After Attack Delay).[/color]
Allows you to memorize and use the last skill that hit you (excluding monster-only skills).
The maximum usable level of the memorized skill increases with skill level, but cannot exceed the original skill’s max level.
Memorized skills do not count as learned skills and are not affected by skill tree requirements or level-boosting effects.
Expanded classes and Transcendent 2nd class skills cannot be memorized.

226.name: Axe Mastery
desc: Description : [color=777777]Adds a damage bonus to physical attacks when using an axe or one-handed sword.[/color]

227.name: Potion Research
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases the effectiveness of HP recovery potions and assists with potion crafting.[/color]

228.name: Prepare Potion
desc: Description : [color=777777]Creates potions and chemical items. Using this skill consumes 1 Mortar Bowl, and the corresponding potion manual is required to craft each potion.[/color]

229.name: Bomb
desc: Description : [color=777777]Throws 1 Molotov Cocktail at the target ground, dealing Fire-Property Melee Physical Damage over time to enemies within a 3 x 3 cell area.[/color]
The flames created by Bomb do not cause knockback and have a chance to destroy the target’s weapon.
Damage per hit increases based on the skill level of Potion Research.

230.name: Acid Terror
desc: Description : [color=777777]Throws 1 Acid Bottle at the target, dealing Ranged Physical Damage and having a chance to inflict [Status Ailment : Bleeding] or destroy the target’s armor.[/color]
As the skill level increases, the chance to inflict Bleeding or destroy armor increases.
Damage scales with the skill level of Potion Research, and the chance to inflict Bleeding is reduced by the target’s Status Ailment resistance.

231.name: Aid Potion
desc: Description : [color=777777]Throws a potion to recover HP of a party member, Guildsman, or Homunculus.[/color]
The recovery effect increases based on skill level, and higher levels allow the use of additional potion types.
Only standard potions can be used, and ranking effects do not apply when using Aid Potion.
When used on a Homunculus, the Heal effect is significantly increased.

232.name: Summon Flora
desc: Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Plant Bottle to summon Plant Monsters that attack enemies on the targeted ground.[/color]
Summoned monsters automatically disappear after a certain time.
Their MHP varies depending on skill level.
Different monsters are summoned by skill level, and only one type can be active at a time.
Lower skill levels allow more monsters to be summoned, while Lv. 5 allows only one monster.

233.name: Summon Marine Sphere
desc: Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Marine Sphere Bottle to summon a Marine Sphere on the targeted ground.[/color]
When attacked, the summoned Marine Sphere moves in the opposite direction of the attacker and triggers a self-destruction skill.
Up to 3 can be summoned at once. In PvP-enabled areas, the explosion can also damage the caster and allies.

234.name: Alchemical Weapon
desc: Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Coating Agent to make the target’s weapon unbreakable and immune to Strip effects for a certain duration.[/color]

235.name: Synthesized Shield
desc: Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Coating Agent to make the target’s shield unbreakable and immune to Strip effects for a certain duration.[/color]

236.name: Synthetic Armor
desc: Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Coating Agent to make the target’s armor unbreakable and immune to Strip effects for a certain duration.[/color]

237.name: Biochemical Helm
desc: Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Coating Agent to make the target’s helm unbreakable and immune to Strip effects for a certain duration.[/color]

238.name: Bioethics
desc: Description : [color=777777]Has no direct effect. This skill simply marks the beginning of the skill tree required to create a Homunculus.[/color]
For those who handle precious life, however, Bioethics can never be emphasized enough.

243.name: Call Homunculus
desc: Description : [color=777777]Calls your Homunculus or creates a new one.[/color]
To recall a Homunculus, it must have been previously created and be in a dormant state via Vaporize.
To create a Homunculus, an Embryo is required.

244.name: Vaporize
desc: Description : [color=777777]Sends your Homunculus into a resting state.[/color]
Can only be used when the Homunculus has at least 80% of its Max HP.
A Homunculus in the Vaporize state can be recalled using Call Homunculus.

247.name: Homunculus Resurrection
desc: Description : [color=777777]Revives a Homunculus that disappeared due to incapacitation.[/color]

248.name: Faith
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases MHP by 200 per skill level and grants Holy property resistance.[/color]

249.name: Guard
desc: For the duration, has a chance to block incoming physical damage.
Triggers a brief delay when a block occurs.
The effect ends when the shield is unequipped, or when used again while Guard is active.

250.name: Smite
desc: Strikes the enemy with a shield, dealing Melee Physical Damage, knocking the target back, and has a chance to inflict Stun.
The chance to inflict Stun is reduced by the target’s status ailment resistance.

251.name: Shield Boomerang
desc: Throws the shield to deal Ranged Physical Damage of Neutral-Property to a distant target.
Damage increases based on the shield’s refinement and weight.

252.name: Shield Reflect
desc: For the duration, reflects a portion of incoming Melee Physical Damage Taken back to the attacker.
The effect is removed if the shield is unequipped during Duration.

253.name: Holy Cross
desc: Description : [color=777777]Strikes the target with a holy cross, dealing Holy-Property Melee Physical Damage and has a chance to inflict Blind.[/color]
The chance to inflict Blind is reduced by the target’s status ailment resistance.
Damage increases based on the caster’s VIT, and is further increased when a spear-type weapon is equipped.

254.name: Grand Cross
desc: Description : [color=777777]Calls down divine judgment in a large cross-shaped area centered on the caster three times, dealing special Holy Magical Damage to targets within range.[/color]
Damage is affected by both ATK and MATK, and consumes 20% of current HP.
Casting is not interrupted when taking damage.
Undead and Demon Monsters, excluding Boss monsters, are inflicted with Blind.
The chance to inflict Blind is reduced by the target’s status ailment resistance.

255.name: Sacrifice
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Resistant Souls Lv. 4, Shield Reflect Lv. 5[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Redirects all damage taken by a designated party member to the caster.[/color]
The level difference between the target and caster must not exceed 16.
The effect is canceled if the target moves out of range, changes maps, or upon death.
Since damage is taken in place of the target, their casting is not interrupted when attacked.
Cannot be used on targets of the same Crusader Class.

256.name: Resistant Souls
desc: Description : [color=777777]For Duration, increases resistance against Demon Monsters and Holy Property Resistance.[/color]
Also increases resistance to Stun, Petrify, Curse, and Confusion.

257.name: Defending Aura
desc: When used, reduces Ranged Physical Damage Taken by a significant amount.
Movement speed and ASPD are reduced while active, but the ASPD penalty decreases by skill level.
Using the skill again cancels the effect. The effect also ends if the shield is unequipped.

258.name: Spear Quicken
desc: Increases ASPD, CRIT, and FLEE Rate.
Duration, CRIT, and FLEE Rate increase by skill level.
The effect ends if the spear is unequipped or a different weapon type is equipped.

259.name: Iron Fists
desc: Description : [color=777777]When attacking with bare hands or Knuckle-type weapons, increases physical damage by an additional amount based on skill level.[/color]

260.name: Spiritual Cadence
desc: Description : [color=777777]While sitting, recovers additional HP and SP every 10 sec.[/color]
When weight exceeds 70% in the Merchant state, recovery occurs every 20 sec.
Recovery per 10 sec is as follows:

261.name: Summon Spirit Sphere
desc: Description : [color=777777]Condenses energy to form Spirit Spheres.[/color]
Spirit Spheres last for 10 min and affect skill usage.
Each Spirit Sphere increases physical damage by 3.

262.name: Spiritual Sphere Absorption
desc: Description : [color=777777]Absorbs Spirit Sphere from yourself or a party member to recover SP.[/color]
In PvP and Guild Battles, can also absorb Spirit Spheres from other Monk Class.
When used on monsters, has a 20% chance to recover SP based on the monster’s level.
Does not affect Boss monsters or Guardians.

263.name: Raging Trifecta Blow
desc: Description : [color=777777]Basic attacks have a 30% chance to trigger a triple-hit attack.[/color]
If Raging Quadruple Blow is learned, a 0.3 sec delay is applied after Raging Trifecta Blow activates, allowing the use of Raging Quadruple Blow.

264.name: Snap
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Fury Lv. 3, Raging Thrust Lv. 3, Mental Strength Lv. 3[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Spirit Sphere to instantly move to the selected cell.[/color]
Fails if the path between the current location and the target cell is blocked.
Does not consume a Spirit Sphere while in Fury.
Cannot use Guillotine Fist for 2 sec after using Snap.

265.name: Flee
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases FLEE Rate based on skill level.[/color]

266.name: Occult Impaction
desc: Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Spirit Sphere to deal special Melee Physical Damage.[/color]
Damage increases with the target’s equipment defense.
When used on a target in Root, skill damage increases by 50%.

267.name: Throw Spirit Sphere
desc: Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Spirit Sphere to deal Ranged Physical Damage.[/color]
When used on a target in Root, damage increases by 50%.

268.name: Mental Strength
desc: Description : [color=777777]Consumes 5 Spirit Sphere to reduce all damage taken by 90%.[/color]
While active, cannot use skills, and movement speed and ASPD are reduced.

269.name: Root
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Flee Lv. 5, Summon Spirit Sphere Lv. 5[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Spirit Sphere to restrain the attacking target, immobilizing both the caster and target for 10 sec.[/color]
During Duration, both cannot act; if either becomes incapacitated, the other can move again.
Higher skill levels allow certain skills to be used while restraining the target.
Duration is reduced when used on Boss monsters.
[color=777777]Guillotine Fist requires the Fury state and at least 1 Spirit Sphere.[/color]

270.name: Fury
desc: Description : [color=777777]Detonates 5 Spirit Sphere to increase CRIT for 180 sec.[/color]
While in Fury, natural SP recovery is reduced by 50%.

271.name: Guillotine Fist
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Fury Lv. 3, Throw Spirit Sphere Lv. 3[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Can only be used while in the Fury state.[/color]
Consumes all remaining SP and all Spirit Sphere to deal special physical damage based on SP consumed.
After use, Fury is canceled and SP cannot be recovered for a short time.

272.name: Raging Quadruple Blow
desc: Description : [color=777777]Can be used during the delay after Raging Trifecta Blow activates.[/color]
Strikes the target 4 times for Melee Physical Damage.
When using Knuckle-class weapons, hits 6 times with double damage.
After learning Raging Thrust, a 0.3 sec delay is applied before it can be used.

273.name: Raging Thrust
desc: Description : [color=777777]Can be used during the delay after Raging Quadruple Blow activates.[/color]
Consumes 1 Spirit Sphere to smash the target for Melee Physical Damage.
Damage increases based on the caster’s STR.
After learning Guillotine Fist, a 0.3 sec delay is applied before it can be used.
Using Guillotine Fist after this skill requires the Fury state and at least 1 Spirit Sphere.

274.name: Study
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases physical damage when attacking with Book-class weapons.[/color]
Also increases ASPD while a Book-class weapon is equipped.

275.name: Cast Cancel
desc: Description : [color=777777]Can only be used while casting a spell.[/color]
Immediately cancels the current cast in exchange for consuming SP of the casting skill.
SP consumption is reduced as skill level increases.

276.name: Magic Rod
desc: Description : [color=777777]When used at the moment a targeted offensive spell would deal damage, negates the damage and absorbs the spell’s SP cost.[/color]
If the caster uses Spell Breaker and it is absorbed by Magic Rod, the caster loses 20% SP.

277.name: Spell Breaker
desc: Description : [color=777777]Can be used on a target that is casting.[/color]
Cancels the cast and absorbs the SP cost of the spell.
Also drains HP equal to 2% of the target’s MHP; at Lv. 5, absorbs half of the HP drained.
HP drain does not apply to Boss monsters or Guardians, and has a 10% success rate on Boss monsters.

278.name: Free Cast
desc: Description : [color=777777]Allows movement and attacks while casting spells, but fixes movement speed and ASPD.[/color]
Movement speed and ASPD vary by skill level.

279.name: Hindsight
desc: When performing basic physical attacks, the selected skill has a chance to activate automatically without casting.
The triggered skill activates at half of the Hindsight skill level and consumes 2/3 of its normal SP cost.
Only learned skills can be selected, and available magic increases with skill level.

280.name: Endow Blaze
desc: Endows the target’s weapon with Fire-Property for the duration and increases Fire Magical Damage.
Can be used on self or party members.

281.name: Endow Tsunami
desc: Endows the target’s weapon with Water-Property for the duration and increases Water Magical Damage.
Can be used on self or party members.

282.name: Endow Tornado
desc: Endows the target’s weapon with Wind-Property for the duration and increases Wind Magical Damage.
Can be used on self or party members.

283.name: Endow Quake
desc: Endows the target’s weapon with Earth-Property for the duration and increases Earth Magical Damage.
Can be used on self or party members.

285.name: Volcano
desc: Creates a Volcano zone in a 7 x 7 area around the target.
Increases Fire-Property damage dealt within the area.
Increases ATK and MATK of targets within the area.
Ice Wall cannot be used in this area.
Cannot overlap with other Sage ground skills.
Duration is equal to skill level in minutes.
Recasting Volcano, Deluge, or Whirlwind during Duration does not consume Blue Gemstone.

286.name: Deluge
desc: Creates a Deluge zone in a 7 x 7 area around the target.
Increases Water-Property damage dealt within the area.
Increases MHP of targets within the area.
Aqua Benedicta and Waterball can be used in this area.
Using Waterball reduces the Deluge area by the skill’s detection range.
Cannot overlap with other Sage ground skills.
Duration equals skill level in minutes.
Recasting Volcano, Deluge, or Whirlwind during Duration does not consume Blue Gemstone.

287.name: Whirlwind
desc: Creates a Whirlwind zone in a 7 x 7 area around the target.
Increases Wind-Property damage dealt within the area.
Increases FLEE Rate of targets within the area.
Extends Fire Wall Duration by 1.5x in this area.
Cannot overlap with other Sage ground skills.
Duration equals skill level in minutes.
Recasting Volcano, Deluge, or Whirlwind during Duration does not consume Blue Gemstone.

288.name: Land Protector
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Volcano Lv. 3, Deluge Lv. 3, Whirlwind Lv. 3[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Yellow Gemstone and 1 Blue Gemstone.[/color]
Prevents any magic from being placed within the area around the target cell.
Any existing ground magic in the created area is removed on cast.
Cannot overlap with other Sage ground skills.

289.name: Dispell
desc: Removes all magical effects applied to the target with a certain chance.
Success chance is affected by the target’s magic defense.
At Lv. 5, the effect succeeds with 100% chance regardless of the target’s magic defense.

290.name: Hocus-pocus
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Hindsight Lv. 5, Dispell Lv. 1, Land Protector Lv. 1[/color]
The number of possible skills that can be randomly activated increases with skill level.
Even if a gemstone consumption–negating effect is active, at least 1 Yellow Gemstone is always consumed.

304.name: Amp
desc: Description : [color=777777]Reduces SP consumption for Performance, Ensemble, and Dance skills by 40% for a certain duration.[/color]
Can be used together with Encore.

305.name: Encore
desc: Description : [color=777777]Recasts the last song or dance used.[/color]
Performance, Dance, and Ensemble skills can be used at half their normal SP cost.
If the previously used skill cannot be recast, only the skill activation occurs and the cooldown is applied.

306.name: Lullaby
desc: Target : [color=777777]9 x 9 cells around self (normal monsters within range)[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Has a chance to inflict Sleep on targets within range.[/color]
The chance and Duration are reduced by the target’s status ailment resistance.
Can overlap with other Ensemble skills.
To activate an Ensemble skill, a Bard and Dancer must be within 9 x 9 cells of each other.
After activation, the caster and partner suffer Ensemble Aftereffect for 10 sec (unable to use skills, reduced movement speed, and reduced ASPD).
Boss monsters are immune to Sleep.

307.name: Mental Sensing
desc: Target : [color=777777]31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range)[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Increases EXP gained from defeating monsters for the caster and party members within range for the duration.[/color]
Cannot overlap with other Ensemble skills.
To activate an Ensemble skill, a Bard and Dancer must be within 9 x 9 cells of each other.
After activation, the caster and partner suffer Ensemble Aftereffect for 10 sec (unable to use skills, reduced movement speed, and reduced ASPD).

308.name: Down Tempo
desc: Target : [color=777777]9 x 9 cells around self (enemy players within range)[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Sets the DEF of enemy players within range to 0 for 60 sec.[/color]
Cannot overlap with other Ensemble skills.
To activate an Ensemble skill, a Bard and Dancer must be within 9 x 9 cells of each other.
After activation, the caster and partner suffer Ensemble Aftereffect for 10 sec (unable to use skills, reduced movement speed, and reduced ASPD).
This skill can only be used in PvP and Siege modes.

309.name: Battle Theme
desc: Target : [color=777777]31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range)[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Increases ATK and DEF of allies within range based on the skill level for the duration.[/color]
Cannot overlap with other Ensemble skills.
To activate an Ensemble skill, a Bard and Dancer must be within 9 x 9 cells of each other.
After activation, the caster and partner suffer Ensemble Aftereffect for 10 sec (unable to use skills, reduced movement speed, and reduced ASPD).

310.name: Harmonic Lick
desc: Target : [color=777777]31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range)[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Randomly grants one of the following beneficial effects to allies within range for 60 sec.[/color]
Cannot overlap with other Ensemble skills.
To activate an Ensemble skill, a Bard and Dancer must be within 9 x 9 cells of each other.
After activation, the caster and partner suffer Ensemble Aftereffect for 10 sec (unable to use skills, reduced movement speed, and reduced ASPD).

311.name: Classical Pluck
desc: Target : [color=777777]9 x 9 cells around self (all players within range, excluding self)[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Disables the use of skills and magic for all targets within range, excluding the caster, for 30 sec.[/color]
Cannot overlap with other Ensemble skills.
To activate an Ensemble skill, a Bard and Dancer must be within 9 x 9 cells of each other.
After activation, the caster and partner suffer Ensemble Aftereffect for 10 sec (unable to use skills, reduced movement speed, and reduced ASPD).
This skill can only be used in PvP and Siege modes.

312.name: Power Cord
desc: Target : [color=777777]31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range)[/color]
Description : [color=777777]For the duration, reduces gemstone consumption by 1 when party members within range use gemstone-consuming magic.[/color]
Cannot overlap with other Ensemble skills.
To activate an Ensemble skill, a Bard and Dancer must be within 9 x 9 cells of each other.
After activation, the caster and partner suffer Ensemble Aftereffect for 10 sec (unable to use skills, reduced movement speed, and reduced ASPD).

313.name: Acoustic Rhythm
desc: Target : [color=777777]31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range)[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Increases Earth, Water, Fire, and Wind resistance of party members within range based on the skill level.[/color]
Also increases resistance to Blind, Petrification, Frozen, Stun, Curse, Sleep, Silence, and Confusion.
Cannot overlap with other Ensemble skills.
To activate an Ensemble skill, a Bard and Dancer must be within 9 x 9 cells of each other.
After activation, the caster and partner suffer Ensemble Aftereffect for 10 sec (unable to use skills, reduced movement speed, and reduced ASPD).

315.name: Music Lessons
desc: Description : [color=777777]Improves instrument combat proficiency and mental focus.[/color]
ATK and After Attack Delay bonuses apply only while an instrument is equipped.

316.name: Melody Strike
desc: Fires a powerful arrow twice, dealing Ranged Physical Damage.
Damage increases with the caster’s INT.
Attack property follows the equipped Arrow.

317.name: Unchained Serenade
desc: Target : [color=777777]9 x 9 cells around self (normal enemy monsters within range)[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Deals Neutral-Property damage to enemies within range using sound waves.[/color]
Damage increases with skill level and job level.
Usable only in PvP and Siege modes.

318.name: Unbarring Octave
desc: Description : [color=777777]Attempts to inflict Frozen on all enemies within the current screen.[/color]
Freeze chance increases with skill level and is reduced by the target’s Status Ailment resistance.
Party members have a low chance to be affected.
In PvP, all players can be affected.

319.name: Perfect Tablature
desc: Target : [color=777777]31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range).[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Increases FLEE and Perfect Dodge for the caster and nearby party members.[/color]
Does not stack with other performance skills.

320.name: Impressive Riff
desc: Target : [color=777777]31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range).[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Increases ASPD for the caster and nearby party members.[/color]
Effect is applied as a reduction to After Attack Delay.
Does not stack with other performance skills.

321.name: Magic Strings
desc: Target : [color=777777]31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range).[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Reduces Variable Casting Time and Global Delay for the caster and nearby party members.[/color]
Does not stack with other performance skills.

322.name: Song of Lutie
desc: Target : [color=777777]31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range).[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Increases MHP and received Heal effect for the caster and nearby party members.[/color]
Does not stack with other performance skills.

323.name: Dance Lessons
desc: Description : [color=777777]Improves proficiency with whips and increases mental focus.[/color]
ATK and CRIT bonuses apply only while a whip is equipped.

324.name: Slinging Arrow
desc: Throws an Arrow using a whip to deal Ranged Physical Damage twice.
Damage is increased by INT and follows the equipped Arrow property.

325.name: Hip Shaker
desc: Target : [color=777777]9 x 9 cells around self (enemies within range).[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Inflicts SP damage once to enemies within range.[/color]
Success chance increases with skill level.
Usable only in PvP and Siege Mode.

326.name: Dazzler
desc: Description : [color=777777]Attempts to inflict Stun on all enemies on screen.[/color]
Stun chance increases with skill level.
Party members may be affected at a low chance.
Chance is reduced by Status Ailment resistance.

327.name: Focus Ballet
desc: Target : [color=777777]31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range).[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Increases HIT of targets within range for the duration.[/color]
Does not stack with other Dance skills.

328.name: Slow Grace
desc: Target : [color=777777]9 x 9 cells around self (enemy players within range).[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Reduces Movement Speed and ASPD of enemy players within range for 60 sec.[/color]
Removes existing Movement Speed and ASPD buffs.
Does not stack with other Dance skills.
Usable only in PvP and Siege Mode.

329.name: Lady Luck
desc: Target : [color=777777]31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range).[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Increases CRIT and Critical Damage of targets within range for the duration.[/color]
Does not stack with other Dance skills.

330.name: Gypsy's Kiss
desc: Target : [color=777777]31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range).[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Increases MSP and reduces SP consumption for skills for all targets within range.[/color]
Does not stack with other dance skills.

355.name: Aura Blade
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Bash Lv. 5, Magnum Break Lv. 5, Two Handed Sword Mastery Lv. 5[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Infuses your weapon with aura, increasing damage when attacking.[/color]
Additional damage is based on your Base Level.

356.name: Parry
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Provoke Lv. 5, Two Handed Sword Mastery Lv. 10, Two Hand Quicken Lv. 3[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Blocks incoming attacks with your sword.[/color]
On a successful block, you take no damage and the attack is negated.

357.name: Spear Dynamo
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Increase HP Recovery Lv. 5, Spear Mastery Lv. 5, Peco Peco Ride Lv. 1[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Increases HIT and ATK while reducing defense, and grants the Endure effect.[/color]
The effect is removed when equipment is changed.

358.name: Relax
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Provoke Lv. 5, Increase HP Recovery Lv. 10, Endure Lv. 3[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Relaxes the body to greatly increase HP recovery.[/color]
The effect is canceled if you stand up, change equipment, or use items.

359.name: Frenzy
desc: Description : [color=777777]Enters a berserk state, increasing HP, ATK, and movement speed, but reducing FLEE Rate.[/color]
You cannot use items or receive healing skills, and HP gradually decreases over time.
After use, natural HP and SP recovery is disabled for 5 minutes.

361.name: Assumptio
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Angelus Lv. 1, Increase SP Recovery Lv. 3, Impositio Manus Lv. 3[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Blesses the target with divine protection, increasing DEF and received Heal Amount for a duration.[/color]

362.name: Basilica
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Gloria Lv. 2, Increase SP Recovery Lv. 1, Kyrie Eleison Lv. 3[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Embraces sacred power, increasing Holy Magical Damage and Physical Damage to Undead Enemies for a duration.[/color]

363.name: Meditation
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Increase SP Recovery Lv. 5, Lex Divina Lv. 5, Aspersio Lv. 3[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Increases Max SP and SP Recovery Rate.[/color]
Slightly increases the healing effect of Heal.

364.name: Soul Drain
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Increase SP Recovery Lv. 5, Soul Strike Lv. 7[/color]
When a monster is defeated by magic, recovers SP based on the monster’s level.
The effect is determined by the skill used immediately before activation.

365.name: Stave Crasher
desc: Description : [color=777777]Strikes a single enemy with Neutral-Property physical damage based on MATK.[/color]
Damage is reduced by the target’s DEF.

367.name: Gloria Domini
desc: Description : [color=777777]Calls down a massive cross to deal Holy Magical Damage.[/color]
Reduces the target’s Holy-Property resistance by 20% for 5 sec.
Damage increases based on the caster’s Base Level.

368.name: Martyr's Reckoning
desc: Description : [color=777777]Sacrifices 9% of the caster’s HP per hit to deal equal damage to the target.[/color]
After use, the next 5 normal melee attacks become special attacks.
This damage may incapacitate the caster.

369.name: Battle Chant
desc: Description : [color=777777]Sings a holy hymn that randomly applies 1 of 10 negative effects to enemies and 1 of 10 positive effects to allies within range.[/color]
Affects all players and enemies within range.
If inflicted with Silence while casting, Battle Chant is canceled.

370.name: Raging Palm Strike
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Iron Fists Lv. 7, Summon Spirit Sphere Lv. 5[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Delivers a powerful palm strike that deals damage after a 1 sec delay and knocks the target back.[/color]
Can only be used while in Fury state.

371.name: Glacier Fist
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Iron Fists Lv. 5, Raging Trifecta Blow Lv. 5, Raging Thrust Lv. 3[/color]
Description : [color=777777]A chained follow-up attack usable after Raging Trifecta Blow, Raging Quadruple Blow, or Raging Thrust.[/color]
Can only be activated after Raging Thrust.
Damage increases based on the caster’s Base Level.

372.name: Chain Crush Combo
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Iron Fists Lv. 5, Summon Spirit Sphere Lv. 5, Glacier Fist Lv. 2[/color]
Description : [color=777777]A chained combo attack that follows Raging Trifecta Blow, Raging Quadruple Blow, Raging Thrust, or Glacier Fist.[/color]
Consumes 1 Spirit Sphere to deal additional damage.
After using Chain Crush Combo, Guillotine Fist can be activated.
After Raging Thrust, the caster may choose to use either Chain Crush Combo or Glacier Fist, but Glacier Fist cannot be used directly after Chain Crush Combo.
Damage increases based on the caster’s STR and Base Level.

373.name: Indulge
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Increase SP Recovery Lv. 1, Magic Rod Lv. 1[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Reduces the caster’s HP by 10% and converts the reduced amount into SP.[/color]
[Lv 1] [color=777777]Restores SP equal to 10% of the reduced HP[/color]
[Lv 2] [color=777777]Restores SP equal to 20% of the reduced HP[/color]
[Lv 3] [color=777777]Restores SP equal to 30% of the reduced HP[/color]
[Lv 4] [color=777777]Restores SP equal to 40% of the reduced HP[/color]
[Lv 5] [color=777777]Restores SP equal to 50% of the reduced HP[/color]

374.name: Soul Exhale
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Magic Rod Lv. 3, Spell Breaker Lv. 2[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Exchanges the caster’s SP with the target’s SP.[/color]
Both parties receive 50% of the exchanged amount.
SP gained through this exchange cannot exceed MAXSP.

375.name: Soul Siphon
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Cast Cancel Lv. 5, Magic Rod Lv. 3, Dispell Lv. 3[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Has a chance to reduce the target’s SP to 0.[/color]
When using Soul Siphon at Lv. 5, deals damage equal to twice the target’s remaining SP at the same time.
If the skill fails, the effect is reflected back to the caster.
This skill can only be used in PvP and Siege modes.

376.name: Advanced Katar Mastery
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Double Attack Lv. 5, Katar Mastery Lv. 7[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Increases the damage of Katar weapons used by Assassin.[/color]

378.name: Enchant Deadly Poison
desc: Description : [color=777777]Coats the weapon with a more potent poison than Enchant Poison.[/color]
Enemies struck by the enchanted weapon have a chance to be afflicted with a powerful poison that rapidly drains HP.

379.name: Soul Destroyer
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Double Attack Lv. 5, Envenom Lv. 5, Cloaking Lv. 3, Enchant Poison Lv. 6[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Deals powerful Ranged Physical Damage to a single target.[/color]
Has a chance equal to half of the caster’s CRIT to inflict a critical hit.
Damage is increased based on the caster’s Base Level, STR, and INT.
Only half of the total Critical Damage bonus is applied.

380.name: Falcon Eyes
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Owl's Eye Lv. 10, Vulture's Eye Lv. 10, Improve Concentration Lv. 10, Falconry Mastery Lv. 1[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Increases all basic stats by 5, and further enhances HIT, damage, and CRIT for the duration.[/color]

381.name: Falcon Assault
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Vulture's Eye Lv. 5, Falconry Mastery Lv. 1, Blitz Beat Lv. 5, Steel Crow Lv. 3[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Commands the falcon to launch a concentrated assault on a single enemy.[/color]
Damage increases based on skill level and the caster’s Base Level.

382.name: Focused Arrow Strike
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Double Strafe Lv. 5, Improve Concentration Lv. 10[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Fires a powerful shot at a single target, dealing Ranged Physical Damage to the target and enemies within a 5 x 5 cell area around it.[/color]
Has an additional chance equal to 50% of the caster’s CRIT to apply Critical Damage.
Only half of the total Critical Damage bonus is applied.
The attack range of Focused Arrow Strike is fixed at 11 cells.

383.name: Wind Walker
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases Movement Speed and FLEE Rate of the caster and party members within a 13 x 13 cell area around self.[/color]
Movement Speed increase does not apply if Increase Agility or other Movement Speed–increasing effects are active.
The Movement Speed bonus is removed if affected by Quagmire or other Movement Speed–reducing effects.

384.name: Shattering Strike
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Skin Tempering Lv. 3, Hilt Binding Lv. 1, Weaponry Research Lv. 5, Power Thrust Lv. 3[/color]
