Description : [color=777777]While Shattering Strike is active, attacking players has a chance to destroy their weapon or armor, while attacking monsters reduces their ATK or DEF.[/color]
The destruction chance increases with skill level.
Additionally, increases the caster’s damage for the duration, with further damage increased based on the caster’s LUK.

387.name: Cart Boost
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Pushcart Lv. 5, Cart Revolution Lv. 1, Change Cart Lv. 1[/color]
Description : [color=777777]While Geneticist Cart Boost is active, increases Movement Speed when a cart is equipped.[/color]
Allows the caster to ignore Decrease Agility and other Movement Speed–reducing effects.

389.name: Stealth
desc: Cannot be detected by Sight, Ruwach, or Improve Concentration.
Unlike Hiding, takes damage from area-of-effect attacks and leaves footprints while moving.
Ineffective against Insect, Demon, and Boss monsters.
Attacking and using skills is disabled while active.
Usable in Siege Mode, but SP consumption is increased by 5 times.
Natural SP recovery is disabled while active.
[Lv 1] [color=777777]Movement Speed 70%, SP Consumption 12 per 10 sec, after 10 sec STR +1[/color]
[Lv 2] [color=777777]Movement Speed 75%, SP Consumption 14 per 10 sec, after 10 sec STR +2[/color]
[Lv 3] [color=777777]Movement Speed 80%, SP Consumption 16 per 10 sec, after 10 sec STR +4[/color]
[Lv 4] [color=777777]Movement Speed 85%, SP Consumption 18 per 10 sec, after 10 sec STR +8[/color]
[Lv 5] [color=777777]Movement Speed 90%, SP Consumption 20 per 10 sec, after 10 sec STR +16[/color]

390.name: Counter Instinct
desc: Description : [color=777777]If the enemy is using a sword-type weapon, has a chance to deflect the attack, reducing damage taken by 50%.[/color]
The deflection chance increases with skill level.
Up to 3 attacks can be deflected after using the skill.
Applies to attacks from all monsters.
Deflected damage is reflected back to the attacker.

394.name: Arrow Vulcan
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Double Strafe Lv. 5, Arrow Shower Lv. 5, Melody Strike Lv. 1 (Slinging Arrow Lv. 1)[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Rapidly fires a large number of Arrows at a single target.[/color]
Bard requires an instrument equipped, and Dancer requires a whip equipped.

395.name: Sheltering Bliss
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 5, Music Lessons Lv. 7[/color]
[color=777777]Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 5, Dance Lessons Lv. 7[/color]
Description : [color=777777]An ensemble skill performed by Bard and Dancer.[/color]
Creates a barrier in a 5 x 5 cells area around the performer that prevents entry.
The barrier does not block magic or ranged attacks.
Cannot be activated if there are obstacles nearby.

396.name: Marionette Control
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 10, Music Lessons Lv. 5[/color]
[color=777777]Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 10, Dance Lessons Lv. 5[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Transfers all of the caster’s base stats to the target.[/color]
The target receives half of each stat transferred, up to a maximum of 99 per stat.
The effect is canceled if the distance between the caster and the target exceeds 7 cells.

397.name: Clashing Spiral
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Spear Mastery Lv. 5, Pierce Lv. 5, Peco Peco Ride Lv. 1, Spear Stab Lv. 5[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Unleashes a spiraling thrust that strikes the target multiple times.[/color]
Damage increases based on weapon weight and immobilizes the target for 1 sec.
Damage increases with skill level, but casting time and after-cast delay also increase.
Usable only when a spear, one-handed sword, or two-handed sword is equipped.

398.name: Traumatic Blow
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Spear Mastery Lv. 9, Peco Peco Ride Lv. 1[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Strikes the target with a powerful blow, with a chance to inflict Bleeding.[/color]
Bleeding targets take additional damage over time.

399.name: Vital Strike
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Spear Mastery Lv. 9, Peco Peco Ride Lv. 1, Cavalier Mastery Lv. 3, Traumatic Blow Lv. 3[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Usable only while wielding a spear.[/color]
Attacks the target’s joints to inflict various effects.
As skill level increases, both damage and the chance to inflict Status Ailment increase.

400.name: Napalm Vulcan
desc: Description : [color=777777]Uses psychokinesis to deal Ghost Magical Damage to a distant target and all enemies in a 3 x 3 area around it, with a low chance to inflict Curse.[/color]
As skill level increases, the number of hits increases, and damage scales with the caster’s Base Level.

401.name: Zen
desc: Description : [color=777777]A technique that gathers inner energy at great risk, instantly summoning up to 5 Spirit Spheres required for Summon Spirit Sphere.[/color]

402.name: Mind Breaker
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Increase SP Recovery Lv. 3, Soul Siphon Lv. 2[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Attacks the target’s mind, causing mental collapse.[/color]
Decreases the target’s magic defense while increasing magic attack power.
Success rate increases with skill level.

403.name: Foresight
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Study Lv. 5, Free Cast Lv. 5, Hindsight Lv. 1[/color]
Description : [color=777777]After using Foresight, the next 5 skill casts have their Variable Casting Time reduced by half.[/color]
The effect remains until all uses are consumed, and is removed upon death.
The casting time of Foresight itself is fixed at 5 sec and is not affected by DEX.

404.name: Blinding Mist
desc: Description : [color=777777]Creates a wall of fog in a 5 x 3 area, inflicting Blind on players or monsters and making attacks more difficult.[/color]
Ranged attacks and magic cast on targets within the area have reduced damage and an increased chance to miss.
In normal fields, the effect applies only to monsters, while in PvP zones it also applies to players.

405.name: Fiber Lock
desc: Fires a Cobweb to bind the target. Up to 2 webs can be active at the same time.
Lasts for 8 sec. Monsters bound by Cobweb have their FLEE Rate reduced by half.
If a bound target is hit by a Fire-Property attack, it takes double damage and is released from the Cobweb.
Has no effect on Boss monsters.

406.name: Meteor Assault
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Katar Mastery Lv. 5, Righthand Mastery Lv. 3, Sonic Blow Lv. 5, Soul Destroyer Lv. 1[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Strikes all targets in a 5 x 5 area around the caster with a powerful blow.[/color]
Enemies hit have a chance to be inflicted with Stun, Blind, or Bleeding.
Damage increases based on the caster’s AGI and Base Level.

407.name: Create Deadly Poison
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Envenom Lv. 10, Detoxify Lv. 1, Enchant Poison Lv. 5[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Creates a deadly poison using various materials and obtains 1 Poison Bottle.[/color]
Required materials: Poison Fang, Cactus Needle, Bee Sting, Poison Mushroom Spore, Karvodailnirol, Frenzy Potion, and Empty Bottle (1 each).
Success rate increases based on DEX and LUK. On failure, 25% of Max HP is lost.
When consumed by an Assassin Cross, it inflicts poison but increases attack speed. If consumed by other players, it causes immediate Suicide.

475.name: Preserve
desc: Description : [color=777777]Prevents skills copied via Intimidate from being overwritten when hit by another skill.[/color]

476.name: Full Divestment
desc: Description : [color=777777]Applies the effects of all four Divest skills simultaneously.[/color]
Success chance increases if your DEX is higher than the target’s DEX.

478.name: Aid Condensed Potion
desc: Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Slim Potion and throws it to recover HP of party members within a 7 x 7 area around the target location.[/color]
Only standard Slim Potions can be used. Ranking bonuses do not apply when using Aid Condensed Potion.

479.name: Full Chemical Protection
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Chemical Protection (Helm, Shield, Armor, Weapon) Lv. 5[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Applies the effects of all four Chemical Protection skills simultaneously.[/color]

480.name: Rapid Smiting
desc: Description : [color=777777]Shield-exclusive skill. Attacks the enemy with a shield.[/color]
Affected by the user’s HIT. Additional damage is added based on the user’s Base Level, shield refinement, and shield weight.

481.name: Spiritual Thrift
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Mace Mastery Lv. 10, Demon Bane Lv. 10[/color]

482.name: Double Bolt
desc: Description : [color=777777]While active, casting Bolt-type skills has a chance to trigger an additional cast.[/color]
Does not reduce Variable Casting Time.

483.name: Ganbantein
desc: Description : [color=777777]Has a chance to cancel all ground-targeted spells within a 3 x 3 area centered on the target cell.[/color]
Consumes 1 Blue Gemstone and 1 Yellow Gemstone.
When used on Land Protector, removes Land Protector within a 3 x 3 area.
Gemstone consumption cannot be reduced by items or skills.

484.name: Gravitational Field
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Quagmire Lv. 1, Stave Crasher Lv. 1, Mystical Amplification Lv. 10[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Creates a surge of gravity within a 5 x 5 area centered on the target cell, dealing Neutral Magical Damage.[/color]
The number of hits increases with skill level, and damage increases based on the caster’s Base Level.

485.name: High Speed Cart Ram
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Mammonite Lv. 10, Geneticist Cart Boost Lv. 1[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Can only be used while Geneticist Cart Boost is active.[/color]
Strikes a single enemy with a cart, consuming Zeny and having a chance to inflict Stun.
Damage increases with skill level and is affected by cart weight.

486.name: Maximum Power-Thrust
desc: Description : [color=777777]Consumes Zeny to greatly increase weapon attack power.[/color]
Unlike Power Thrust, this effect applies only to the caster.
The effect is removed when changing equipment.

488.name: Hermode's Rod
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 10, Music Lessons Lv. 10[/color]
[color=777777]Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 10, Dance Lessons Lv. 10[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Can only be used in Siege Mode when a Warp Zone is present nearby.[/color]
Removes all buff magic except Frenzy from all allied characters within range (excluding the caster) and renders them immune to magic.
The effect ends immediately when leaving the area. While within the area, allied players including the caster cannot use skills.

489.name: Tarot Card of Fate
desc: [color=777777]Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 10, Unchained Serenade Lv. 3[/color]
[color=777777]Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 10, Hip Shaker Lv. 3[/color]
Description : [color=777777]Attempts to affect a single enemy. On success, applies one of 14 random card effects.[/color]
Success chance increases with skill level.

490.name: Acid Bomb
desc: Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Molotov Cocktail and 1 Acid Bottle to deal Ranged Physical Damage to a target.[/color]
Damage increases based on the caster’s INT, the target’s VIT, and the caster’s Base Level.
Deals only 50% damage to non-monster characters and may damage the target’s weapon and armor based on skill level.

1001.name: Charge Attack
desc: Description : [color=777777]Rushes toward a distant enemy and strikes instantly, dealing ATK 700% damage and knocking the target back by 2 cells. Knockback increases to 4 cells in PvP areas, and is removed entirely in siege areas.[/color]

1002.name: Shrink
desc: Description : [color=777777]For 15 min, successfully auto-guarding with Guard has a high chance to inflict Status Ailment Stun on the attacker. Using Shrink again during its duration cancels the effect.[/color]

1003.name: Sonic Acceleration
desc: Description : [color=777777]When using Sonic Blow, increases HIT by 90% and boosts Sonic Blow damage by 90%.[/color]

1004.name: Venom Knife
desc: Description : [color=777777]Throws 1 equipped Venom Knife at the target, dealing ATK 500% Ranged Physical Damage. The target has a high chance to be inflicted with Status Ailment Poison.[/color]

1005.name: Close Confine
desc: Description : [color=777777]Restrains the target for 10 sec, preventing movement. The caster is also immobilized. While restraining, increases FLEE by 50. The effect is canceled if either character uses Fly Wing, Butterfly Wing, or Teleport, becomes incapacitated, is affected by knockback, the distance between them increases, or the caster enters Hiding. Does not apply to boss monsters.[/color]

1006.name: Sight Blaster
desc: Description : [color=777777]For 15 min, flames of Sight orbit around the caster for protection. When an enemy approaches within 3 x 3 cells around the caster, the flame deals MATK 600% Fire Magical Damage and knocks the target back by 3 cells. The flame dissipates after dealing damage.[/color]

1007.name: Create Elemental Converter
desc: Description : [color=777777]Creates Elemental Converter items. Can create four types: Water, Wind, Earth, and Fire-Property.[/color]
[Converter (Wind)] [color=777777]Wind of Verdure x1 + Empty Scroll x1[/color]

1008.name: Elemental Change - Water
desc: Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Water-Property Elemental Converter to change the target monster’s property to Water-Property with a certain chance.[/color]

1009.name: Phantasmic Arrow
desc: Description : [color=777777]Creates a phantom Arrow even without arrows equipped and fires it at the target, dealing ATK 500% Ranged Physical Damage as Wind-Property damage. Knocks the target back by 3 cells on hit.[/color]

1010.name: Pang Voice
desc: Description : [color=777777]Emits a terrifying scream with a high chance to inflict Status Ailment Confusion and Bleeding on the target. Has no effect on boss monsters.[/color]

1011.name: Charming Wink
desc: Description : [color=777777]Sends a charming wink to distract the target, with a high chance to inflict Status Ailment Confusion and Hallucination. Has no effect on boss monsters.[/color]

1012.name: Dubious Salesmanship
desc: Description : [color=777777]Reduces the Zeny cost of Mammonite and High Speed Cart Ram by 20%.[/color]

1014.name: Redemptio
desc: Description : [color=777777]Leaves the caster with 1 HP and resurrects all party members on the screen. Revived players recover 50% HP.[/color]

1015.name: Spiritual Bestowment
desc: Description : [color=777777]Allows the caster to transfer collected Spirit Sphere to party members. Each cast transfers 1 Spirit Sphere.[/color]

1016.name: Excruciating Palm
desc: Description : [color=777777]Consumes 200 HP to focus energy into the palm, dealing ATK 800% Melee Physical Damage to the target, with a chance to inflict Status Ailment Stun on nearby enemies and knock them back.[/color]

1017.name: Elemental Change - Ground
desc: Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Earth-Property Elemental Converter to change the target monster’s property to Earth-Property with a certain chance.[/color]

1018.name: Elemental Change - Fire
desc: Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Fire-Property Elemental Converter to change the target monster’s property to Fire-Property with a certain chance.[/color]

1019.name: Elemental Change - Wind
desc: Description : [color=777777]Consumes 1 Wind-Property Elemental Converter to change the target monster’s property to Wind-Property with a certain chance.[/color]

2041.name: Clementia
desc: Description : [color=777777]Grants all nearby party members the Acolyte skill [Blessing] effect centered on the caster. The higher the caster’s Job Lv, the stronger the Blessing effect.[/color]
[Lv 1] [color=777777]Effect Range: 3 cells around the caster / Duration 120 sec[/color]
[Lv 2] [color=777777]Effect Range: 7 cells around the caster / Duration 180 sec[/color]
[Lv 3] [color=777777]Effect Range: 15 cells around the caster / Duration 240 sec[/color]

2042.name: Cantocandidus
desc: Description : [color=777777]Grants all nearby party members the Acolyte skill [Increase Agility] effect centered on the caster. The higher the caster’s Job Lv, the more AGI and ASPD (After Attack Delay reduction) are additionally increased.[/color]
[Lv 1] [color=777777]Effect Range: 3 cells around the caster / Duration 120 sec[/color]
[Lv 2] [color=777777]Effect Range: 7 cells around the caster / Duration 180 sec[/color]
[Lv 3] [color=777777]Effect Range: 15 cells around the caster / Duration 240 sec[/color]

2054.name: Duple Light
desc: Description : [color=777777]Summons two holy lights that deal additional damage to the target when performing melee attacks.[/color]

2276.name: Axe Mastery
desc: Description : [color=777777]Increases ATK and HIT when equipping an axe. Maces also receive a minor bonus.[/color]

2278.name: Axe Boomerang
desc: Description : [color=777777]Throws an axe at a distant enemy, dealing damage and knocking the target back. Damage increases based on the axe’s weight.[/color]

2279.name: Power Swing
desc: Description : [color=777777]Swings the weapon with great force at a single target, dealing Melee Physical Damage and inflicting [Status Ailment : Stun]. Damage increases based on the caster’s Base Level, STR, and DEX.[/color]

2280.name: Axe Tornado
desc: Description : [color=777777]Rapidly spins an axe to create a violent storm, dealing Melee Physical Damage to enemies around self.[/color]
Damage increases based on the caster’s Base Lv and VIT.

2286.name: Shadow Spell
desc: Description : [color=777777]Allows magic skills learned through Intimidate to be used via Shadow Spell.[/color]
Increases magic attack for the duration, and basic physical attacks have a chance to trigger the learned magic skill.

2288.name: Triangle Shot
desc: Description : [color=777777]Fires Arrow at a single enemy, dealing Ranged Physical Damage.[/color]
Damage increases based on the caster’s Base Lv and AGI.

2307.name: Cannon Spear
desc: Description : [color=777777]Spear-exclusive skill. Deals Ranged Physical Damage to a target enemy and all enemies within range.[/color]
Damage increases based on the caster’s Base Lv and STR.
Applies Critical Damage based on the caster’s CRIT, with only half of the total Critical Damage bonus applied.

2338.name: Rising Dragon
desc: Description : [color=777777]Temporarily unleashes the caster’s inner energy, increasing the maximum number of Spirit Sphere.[/color]
Increases MHP and MSP by (Skill Lv)% and maintains Fury status for the duration.

2445.name: Spell Fist
desc: Description : [color=777777]When used while casting Fire, Cold, or Lightning Bolt, the bolt casting is Middle, concentrating magic power into the caster’s hands.[/color]
While active, basic attacks have a chance to deal bolt magic damage to the target.
Higher Skill Lv increases the additional damage. Effect ends when Duration expires.

5068.name: Skilled Special Singer
desc: Description : [color=777777]Immediately removes ensemble aftereffects after a Gypsy and Clown ensemble skill.[/color]
